third_party_cartridges.summary: No Pantum page I opened says whether the BP2300 family blocks non-genuine toner. Pantum's product page only links to a general 'Consumables Anti-Counterfeiting Identification' page. Compatible toner is sold in Israel, so the cartridge can be replaced by a third party, but whether the printer accepts it is unverified.

windows.why: Driverless install works on Windows 8.1 to 11 and Pantum lists Windows 11 support, but evidence is thin (three press reviews, mostly of the BP2300W) and reviewers report only a one-time setup annoyance.
windows.driver: Windows 10 and 11 install it without a manual driver (driverless, the driver installs on first connection, per the Inforeco and Adam Lobo pages). Pantum's own page offers a one-step driver download with Windows 11 32/64-bit listed. Adam Lobo reports that a CD driver is included. The Pantum driver download page itself was not opened.
problems: Setup on Windows goes over USB first, and Wi-Fi is configured afterwards (pokde review: 'a bit of puzzle solving')
The Pantum mobile app finds the printer only when the device is on the same Wi-Fi network (adamlobo)

sources.what: Pantum page for BP2300NW: 'One-step Driver Installation', driver download link, Windows 11 (32 and 64-bit) listed, USB cable in the box.
Retailer page for BP2300W: driverless install, driver installs automatically on first connection; Windows 8.1, 10 and 11 listed.
BP2300W review (Adam Lobo TV): driverless install on Windows 8.1, 10 and 11; a CD driver is included; other systems use drivers from Pantum's website; Wi-Fi setup straightforward.
BP2300W review (Hitech Century): setup described as a relatively simple task; a Windows app is available; the printer runs its own installation once connected to a PC.
BP2300W review (Pokde, Malaysia): on Windows the printer works over USB first and Wi-Fi is set up afterwards, which the reviewer found fiddly; the mobile app setup was easier.

forums.why: No Reddit thread, Pantum community forum thread or Israeli owner discussion for the BP2300, BP2300W or BP2300NW turned up; the four sources read are press reviews and a retailer rating summary, not owner posts.
praise: Cheap per page for light use (Pokde: about RM0.12 per page)
Crisp small text and quick first page (Hitech Century, testberichte.de)
Easy setup through the mobile app (testberichte.de, Adam Lobo)
Compact, suited to home or small office (Adam Lobo)
Amazon.de customer average 4.6 from 69 ratings (shown on testberichte.de; the individual reviews were not read)
complaints: Weak on detailed images, with grid or banding lines (Hitech Century)
No automatic duplex; duplex is manual (Adam Lobo, Hitech Century)
Drum and toner are one unit that must be replaced together, which raises running cost (Adam Lobo)
150-sheet input tray may be limiting for high volume (Adam Lobo)

sources.what: Review of the BP2300W, score 8.3/10. Good for light and family use; cost per page about RM0.12; loud; USB-first setup on Windows.
Review of the BP2300W, rated 3.4. Adequate for simple mono jobs; crisp small text; weak images with banding; rather noisy.
Review of the BP2300W, March 2025. Solid for budget users; no auto duplex; no Ethernet; drum and toner are one unit; can get quite loud.

German review of the BP2300W: fast, easy setup via the app, noise is a weakness; the page cites an Amazon.de average of 4.6 from 69 ratings. Its scores contradict each other, so not used for a rating.

not_found: High-yield cartridge for this family: none on Pantum's pages or the Israeli shops. Only TL-*2310H (1,600 pages) and the starter (700 pages) were found.

Starter code: the Pantum pages list only TL-*2310H, so the starter code TL-C2310E comes from the reviews only. Specs.json cites payngo.co.il for the TL-A2310H (TL-2310H) code and 1,600 pages; payngo.co.il returned HTTP 403 and could not be opened, so that page is not used here.
Drum: the drum is built into the cartridge (Adam Lobo: 'the drum and toner are a single unit'). Pantum's pages do not state this. No separate drum unit exists in the Pantum product pages I opened.
USD price of the original cartridge: searched Amazon, B&H and the US market; no US listing turned up. Only European prices were found (Varlė.lt EUR 42.13 used as price_other).

Official Israeli importer or distributor of Pantum: not found. bug.co.il's Pantum page does not name one in its first 100,000 characters. Techno-Rezef appeared in a search but is not confirmed as a Pantum distributor.
Non-genuine toner blocking, firmware, chip behaviour: no Pantum-specific source found. Results were all HP, Brother or Kyocera.
Reddit (r/printers and similar): searched; no BP2300 thread found.
Pantum community or support forum threads for the BP2300 family: none found. The threads that came up are for other models (P2500W, P2502W, BM2300AW, P3012DW, Pantum 200W), so they were not used.
Israeli owner reviews (zap.co.il reviews, HWzone): none found for this model.
Windows problems not found for this model: offline status, sleep and wake, forced accounts, broken Windows updates, Windows on ARM. Searches returned only other models.
Pantum driver download page: not reached. Third-party driver databases (Treexy) list BP2300 versions but are not the maker's site, so they are not used.
Compatible cartridge yield: the Israeli compatible listing does not state a yield in the page I read, so no cost per page is given for it.
Printer price in Israel: payngo.co.il (the specs.json source) returned HTTP 403, so the 449 ILS figure in specs.json was not checked.
